description.text: The promos of the Scarlet & Violet Series, released from January 2023 to October 2025. The set began with the Paldea Collection, nearly two months after the Pokémon Scarlet and Violet games, and dropped the prefix from card numbers: they read 001, 002 and so on, with the set code SVP. Most came in blisters, boxes, collections, tins and Elite Trainer Boxes, including the Pokémon Center editions, and in the Build & Battle Boxes of each prerelease, with staff copies. A few stand apart: Pikachu with Grey Felt Hat from the Pokémon x Van Gogh collaboration, three cards from the 2024 Illustration Contest, Pikachu for players at the Worlds Celebration events, and the World Championships trophy card Paradise Resort.

sources.title: Van Gogh Museum: The Van Gogh Museum Partners with The Pokémon Company International (27 September 2023)
PkmnCards: Pikachu with Grey Felt Hat · Scarlet & Violet Promos (SVP) #085

description.text:
Naoyo Kimura painted Pikachu in the hat and the swirl of short blue strokes flecked with orange of Vincent van Gogh's Self-Portrait with Grey Felt Hat (Paris, 1887) for the Van Gogh Museum's fiftieth-anniversary collaboration with Pokémon: one of six Pokémon paintings after Van Goghs that hung in the museum from 28 September 2023 to 7 January 2024, and the only one made into a card. Its attack, Pika-Portrait, searches the deck for a Pikachu and puts it onto the Bench.

The card was the reward for finishing the museum's Pokémon Adventure leaflet and a gift with the Pokémon Center × Van Gogh Museum merchandise online, and the rush for it made the museum stop handing it out after 13 October 2023. Shops in the Netherlands gave it away with purchases of Pokémon cards in February 2024. Because it was not distributed worldwide, it could not be played at the 2024 World Championships, though it stayed legal in other Standard tournaments.
